input.name: event_id
input.label: Event ID
input.hint: ID of event to update

input.name: shared_calendar
input.label: Shared calendar
input.hint: Provide email address of user of the shared calendar to fetch shared calendars, e.g. support@workato.onmicrosoft.com . If left blank, Workato shows your default calendars.

input.name: Calendar
input.label: Calendar
input.hint: Select the calendar from list.

input.name: StartTimeZone
input.label: Start timezone
input.hint: Select a specific timezone.

input.name: End
input.label: End time

input.label: End timezone
input.hint: Select a specific timezone. If End time zone is not provided, Start time zone will be used for End time

input.name: Subject

input.name: Body

input.hint: Short description about this event

input.name: Attendees
